channel.title: Press releases | Office of the Governor
channel.description: Press releases of the Office of the Governor, the Lieutenant Governor, ministries and agencies of the Irad Special Economic Zone.

item.title: Investment in Sary-Bulak District's Mining Sector Reaches US$216.6 Million
item.description: On a working visit to Sary-Bulak District on Thursday, Lieutenant Governor Aidar Maksat was informed that investment in the district's mining sector has reached US$216.6 million. Investors have indicated that about 2% of their sales will go towards district roads, schools and clinics.

item.title: Record Harvest Lifts ISEZ Farm Output to IS 6.1 Billion in Nine Months
item.description: The Ministry of Economy's preliminary estimate puts ISEZ agricultural output for January to September 2026 at IS 6.1 billion, with volume up about 12% on the same period of 2025. The result is one of the pillars of the 9.4% growth reported by the Bank of Irad.

item.title: Record 700 Participants Attend Nurzhan Oil and Gas Conference
item.description: The annual Nurzhan Oil and Gas Conference, hosted by NurGaz and opened by the Minister of Natural Resources, closed on 23 October with about 700 registered participants, some 40% more than in 2025.

item.title: Lieutenant Governor Presents Plan for a Refinery at Kochkor-Ata to Serve the Southern Districts
item.description: Lieutenant Governor Aidar Maksat told residents of Lower Naryn District that the government wants a second, smaller refinery at Kochkor-Ata to bring fuel closer to the southern districts. He described it as a plan to be studied, not a decision.

item.title: Lieutenant Governor visits the construction site of the Nurzhan Compute Park
item.description: Aidar Maksat and the Director-General of Attelkom, Samat Kasymov, inspected the first phase of a planned US$450 million data-centre hub in Nurzhan's Eastern Industrial Zone.

item.title: 88 investment agreements worth US$2.4 billion signed in three years
item.description: The first full tally of investment agreements since late 2023 shows energy, antimony and logistics drawing most foreign capital.

item.title: Draft order on a temporary halt to table potato imports published for comment
item.category: Ministry of Agriculture and Water Resources
item.description: After a record harvest of about 210,000 tonnes, the ministry proposes to stop imports of table potatoes until 1 March 2027. Comments are open until 30 October.

item.title: Census of business entities begins: enumerators visit firms, farms and stalls until 30 November
item.description: The first count of all business entities in the ISEZ runs from 15 October to 30 November. Answers are used for statistics only.

item.title: Preliminary harvest figures: 1.2 million tonnes of grain and 210,000 tonnes of potatoes
item.description: The Chu and Talas valleys have brought in one of the strongest harvests in years. Grain is up by about two-fifths on last year.

item.title: Phased restart announced for the Sary-Bulak Antimony Works and the Chatkal smelter
item.description: Speaking to residents and plant staff in Sary-Bulak, the Lieutenant Governor said idle lines will return in stages, with the first stage expected to create around 600 jobs.

item.title: Customs roadmap with Kazakhstan for 2027–2028 signed at Kyzyl-Adyr
item.description: Electronic pre-clearance at the Talas North Terminal, a shared schedule of inspection hours and a separate lane for low-risk lorries.

item.title: Toktogul refit raises capacity to 1,440 MW
item.description: Each of the four generating units now delivers 360 MW instead of 300. The Minister of Natural Resources reviewed the work at the Lower Naryn switchyard and the National Dispatch Centre.

item.title: Statement on the restriction of websites offering unlicensed financial services
item.description: At the request of financial supervisors, the website of the “Tulparcoin” token and the foreign platform on which it trades have been added to the list of restricted sites.

item.title: Lieutenant Governor opens a solar-powered school in Navbahor, Nurzhan
item.description: The 24-classroom school is the twelfth school or kindergarten completed this year. Eighteen more are due before the end of December.

item.title: Magnitude 4.9 tremor in the Kara-Unkur valley: no damage reported
item.description: The district emergency service checked bridges, schools and the switchyard within the hour. Residents of older mudbrick houses are asked to check walls and chimneys before the heating season.

item.title: Bank of Irad: payment services require a licence
item.description: Any service that takes payments or holds funds for residents of the ISEZ needs a licence under the 1993 Act, whatever the instrument it uses.

item.title: Executive Directive 2026/31 sets at least IS 41 million for school textbooks
item.description: A four-year printing programme for 2027–2030, expert review of every new title and a code on each copy showing the school and pupil it was issued to.

item.title: Bank of Irad statement on the token marketed as “Tulparcoin”
item.description: The token is not legal tender, is not backed by the bank's dollar reserves and carries no deposit protection. Only the som and the US dollar are legal tender.

item.title: The Governor's greeting on the Feast of St. Janyl
item.description: Governor Erlan Toktarov greeted the faithful and the pilgrims gathered at Iyık Janyl. The address was broadcast on IradOne.

item.title: ISEZ economy grew 1.5 per cent in 2024
item.description: Beef exports from the Talas valley and steady refinery output put growth ahead of the government's spring forecast.

item.title: Memorandum on trade and border coordination signed with Uzbekistan
item.description: Shared customs inspection hours at the main crossings and a joint working group on livestock and cotton shipments.
